input.title: Give the Topic dropdown an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale:
The <select id="topic"> has no accessible name. The visible "Topic" label on line 11 has no for attribute, so it isn't linked to the dropdown. I can only edit the select itself, so this patch adds aria-label="Topic". That uses the same word as the visible label, so voice-control users can say it and screen readers will announce it.

A better fix outside this patch: add for="topic" to the <label> on line 11, then remove this aria-label. That links the visible label directly, and clicking the label will then focus the dropdown. Please check this fix with assistive technology. It does not by itself make the page compliant.
